ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite will be enforced. This section will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition and Advertising majors on Monday, April 15, 2013 and to business minors on Monday, April 22, 2013 at approximately 9:00 a.m. There are currently 10 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 30, 2013 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This is a core course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
